blocks.text: @ghai.gpt (Concord sniper) badly wounded @0__freddie__0. @csllgaks (Concord machine gunner) grazed @wolfmanantony. @leo.glc (Concord stretcher bearer) grazed @slightlyretarded69.
Hegemony: aid post 1/2 beds, 0/6 stretchers, medics covering 100% of the wounded. Concord: aid post 0/2 beds, 0/6 stretchers, medics covering 100% of the wounded.
Clear weather exposed paths usually hidden by haze. Carrying parties waited for darkness rather than risk the open stretches.

115 new soldiers came up the line. Hegemony: @lorenzo_sapino_, @fransinlak, @acakostic11, @austintress, @deadeyesimulacrum, @matteozrybak, @galvanooooo, @carlingiti and 45 more. Concord: @pbscn_, @jiri.satalik, @topekeno, @yee.zle, @knightowlvt, @v01py, @vuminhtri260709, @spencerbonthoux and 54 more.

items: At the Weeping Orchard, Albin Chloe of the Hegemony and Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord fired at the same loose sheet of metal. The wind kept winning. (@chloe.g.t, @es31230)

Yann Vee (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) met in the same shell hole at Calvary Farm during a raid. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone. (@ask._.vee, @reza_zdsh)
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal kept the tin. (@hodnepijumaloctu, @a_k_biwott)
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Chalk Pits, Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso was promoted to Lance Corporal. (@jozifanderson)
Konrad Jngaf repaired the strap on Jakub Ebrrrvole's pack. Payment was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. (@gremlin_jngaf, @ebrrrvole)
